Maya (CS Ops): Heads up — onboarding feedbacks are landing in the general form instead of the CS feedback queue. Saw ~45 in the last 24h, and it's polluting healthscore sampling.
Liam (DevEx): @Maya can you drop an example id so I can inspect the webhook mapping?
Maya (CS Ops): Example FEED-4923 -> https://our-ops/feedback/FEED-4923 payload shows "form_source": "general" and no "cs_tag".
Anya (Enablement): We updated the onboarding form last week and renamed fields. I think the webhook matcher expects form_source but the new form uses source_origin. Oops.
Noah (SRE): Quick check SQL: SELECT id FROM feedback WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND (form_source IS NULL OR form_source = 'general'); will run now.
Maya (CS Ops): If we can patch the webhook to fallback to source_origin -> cs_feedback that should stop new ones misrouting. Also would like a dry-run reclass job to move the last 48.
Liam (DevEx): I'll push a tiny fallback in the webhook handler to staging. Patch snippet:
```
if (!payload.form_source && payload.source_origin) {
  payload.form_source = payload.source_origin;
}
routeToQueue(payload.form_source);
```
Anya (Enablement): After staging patch, can we run the reclass dry-run and compare counts against healthscore snapshots? I want to confirm no double-counting.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging webhook patch deployed (rev c3a7) at 2024-07-12T15:04Z :white_check_mark:
Noah (SRE): Dry-run results: 48 candidates, 46 would be moved to cs_queue. No failures in staging. Opened PR for one-off job: https://our-repo/pr/381.
Maya (CS Ops): Nice — schedule prod run after 2pm PT and please tag items with migration:true so we can exclude from sampling next week.
Liam (DevEx): Will add migration:true flag and a short TTL tag. Planning prod deploy 14:10 PT.
Anya (Enablement): After prod run let's snapshot healthscore and compare baseline -> we should capture delta in the ops doc.
Maya (CS Ops): Great. Thanks team. I'll create a short runbook note under Ops > CS Feedback Reroute and paste the PR + results. :thumbsup:
